cardOverview.overviewText: A travel-focused card from Equitas offering PowerMiles on flight and hotel bookings, with accelerated points on travel spends and flexible redemption for frequent flyers.
cardOverview.bestSuited: Airline Transfer, Hotel Transfer, Travel Booking

benefitRows.name: Club Marriott
benefitRows.offer: Get up to 20% off on hotel stays, dining, and beverages at participating Marriott hotels. Additionally, they receive a flat 20% discount on spa services, along with a complimentary spouse membership for extended benefits.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail your Club Marriott membership, check your email for the activation link and membership number. Download the Club Marriott app, open it, and tap “Activate Membership.” Enter your membership number or registered mobile number, set a 6-digit PIN, and complete activation. Once activated, enjoy exclusive benefits at participating Marriott hotels.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: 24*7 Concierge Offers assistance on Flight Bookings, Hotel Reservations etc. are available.
benefitRows.howToAvail: For support, call 1800 103 1222 or email customerservice@equitasbank.com.
